description: 话题模板配置文件，支持通过修改此文件扩展话题，无需改代码

餐饮.description: Ordering drinks and food at a coffee shop or café
Sitting down at a restaurant, ordering from the menu, and paying the bill

出行.description: Checking in luggage and going through security at an airport
Taking a taxi or rideshare like Uber — giving directions and making small talk
Checking in at a hotel, asking for amenities, and checking out

购物.description: Shopping for clothes — asking for sizes, colors, and trying items on
Grocery shopping and asking store staff where to find items

医疗.description: Visiting a doctor, describing symptoms, and understanding a prescription

职业.description: Calling customer service to report a problem or request a refund
A business meeting — presenting ideas, giving feedback, and discussing next steps

社交.description: Making small talk at a party — introducing yourself and discussing hobbies
Renting an apartment — asking the landlord about rules, utilities, and repairs
